profile.summary: Carty Web Strategies operates Home Campus, a software company that makes tools for high school sports. Its products handle athletic clearance paperwork, game scheduling, injury tracking and association management for school athletic departments and sports associations. The company started in 2010 to serve the CIF Southern Section.
